rationales: Butter is classified here as liquid dispersed in a semisolid solid matrix.
Butter is not a liquid solution of one liquid in another.
Butter is not a solid dispersed in a liquid.
Butter is not a solid-in-solid solution such as an alloy.
Nitrogen is not +1 in HNO₃.
Nitrogen is not +3 in HNO₃.
Nitrogen is +5 because 1 + x + 3(−2) = 0.
Nitrogen is not +7 in HNO₃.
Sulphur is generally dull, not lustrous.
Phosphorus is generally not lustrous.
Iodine is a lustrous non-metal.
Carbon is not the lustrous non-metal intended here.
A covalent bond forms when atoms share electrons.
Donation of electrons is associated with ionic bonding, not covalent bonding.
Acceptance of electrons is associated with ionic bonding, not covalent bonding.
Repulsion of electrons does not form a covalent bond.
CO₂ has three atoms per molecule.
H₂O has three atoms per molecule.
O₃ has three atoms per molecule.
H₂ has only two atoms per molecule, so it is not triatomic.
Acetic acid ionizes only partially in water, making it a weak electrolyte.
Sulphuric acid is a strong electrolyte.
Sodium chloride dissociates extensively into ions in water.
Sodium hydroxide dissociates extensively into ions in water.
Grams of solute per 100 cm³ of solution is mass/volume percentage, % m/v.
% V/m expresses volume of solute per mass of solution.
% m/m expresses mass of solute per mass of solution.
% V/V expresses volume of solute per volume of solution.
BF₃ is electron deficient because boron has only six electrons in its valence shell.
NH₃ has an octet around nitrogen.
N₂ has a stable triple bond and complete octets.
O₂ has complete octets around both oxygen atoms.
The first period contains two elements, not one.
The first period contains hydrogen and helium, so it has two elements.
The first period does not contain three elements.
Ten elements occur in the second period, not the first.

6.02 × 10²¹ is too small for Avogadro’s number.
6.02 × 10⁻²² has the wrong magnitude and sign of exponent.

Fluorine is heavier than hydrogen and therefore diffuses more slowly.
Chlorine is much heavier and diffuses more slowly.
Helium is lighter than fluorine and chlorine but heavier than hydrogen gas.
Hydrogen has the smallest molar mass among these gases and diffuses fastest.
Protons are charged and interact with matter, limiting their penetration.
Alpha particles are strongly ionizing and have low penetrating power.
Neutrons are uncharged and are the most penetrating particle listed.
Electrons are charged and are less penetrating than neutrons.
The O shell is the fifth shell and contains five subshells.
The N shell is the fourth shell and contains four subshells.
The L shell is the second shell and contains two subshells.
The M shell is the third shell and contains three subshells.
Dilution does not make a saturated solution supersaturated.
After solvent is added, the solution is no longer saturated at the same temperature.
Adding solvent lowers the concentration, so the solution is not more concentrated.
Dilution makes the solution unsaturated because it can dissolve more solute.
Ice is less dense than liquid water, not denser.
Its crystalline structure contributes to its lower density, but this option alone does not state the reason directly.
Water is denser than ice, so ice floats.
Random molecular motion is not the reason ice floats.
